notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug that prevented achievements from being triggered.
 Improved player movement for a smoother gameplay experience.
 Adjustments to level design to make certain moments more balanced and fair.
 Updated sprite font in the pause menu for better visual clarity.

🎮 Update your game and enjoy the improvements!
